an10.27:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an10.27:1.2: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃsu.
an10.27:1.3: Atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi
an10.27:1.5: yan nūna mayaṃ yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo ten' upasaṅkameyyāmā' ti.
an10.27:2.1: Atha kho te bhikkhū yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu,
an10.27:2.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinne kho te bhikkhū te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā etad avocuṃ:-- 2.
an10.27:3.1: Samaṇo āvuso Gotamo sāvakānaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ deseti
an10.27:3.2: ‘etha tumhe bhikkhave sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhijānātha, sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhiññāya abhiññāya viharathā' ti.
an10.27:3.3: Mayam pi kho āvuso sāvakānaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ desema
an10.27:3.4: ‘etha tumhe āvuso sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhijānātha, sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhiññāya abhiññāya viharathā' ti.
an10.27:3.5: Idha no āvuso ko viseso ko adhippāyoso kiṃ nānākaraṇaṃ samaṇassa vā Gotamassa amhākaṃ vā, yad idaṃ dhammadesanāya vā dhammadesanaṃ anusāsaniyā vā anusāsanin ti? 3.
an10.27:4.1: Atha kho te bhikkhū tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandiṃsu na ppaṭikkosiṃsu,
an10.27:4.3: ‘Bhagavato santike etassa bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānissāmā' ti.
an10.27:5.1: Atha kho te bhikkhū Sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:-- 4.
an10.27:6.1: Idha mayaṃ bhante pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisimha.
an10.27:6.2: Tesaṃ no bhante amhākaṃ etad ahosi
an10.27:6.4: yan nūna mayaṃ yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo ten' upasaṅkameyyāmā' ti.
an10.27:6.5: Atha kho mayaṃ bhante yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo ten' upasaṅkamimha, upasaṅkamitvā tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ sammodimha,
an10.27:6.6: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdimha. Ekamantaṃ nisinne kho bhante aññatitthiyā paribbājakā amhe etad avocuṃ:
an10.27:7.1: Samaṇo āvuso Gotamo sāvakānaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ deseti
an10.27:7.2: ‘etha tumhe bhikkhave sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhijānātha, sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhiññāya abhiññāya viharathā' ti.
an10.27:7.3: Mayam pi kho āvuso sāvakānaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ desema
an10.27:7.4: ‘etha tumhe āvuso sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhijānātha, sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhiññāya abhiññāya viharathā' ti.
an10.27:7.5: Idha no āvuso ko viseso ko adhippāyoso kiṃ nānākaraṇaṃ samaṇassa vā Gotamassa amhākaṃ vā, yad idaṃ dhammadesanāya vā dhammadesanaṃ anusāsaniyā vā anusāsanin ti?
an10.27:8.1: Atha kho mayaṃ bhante tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandimha na ppaṭikkosimha,
an10.27:8.3: ‘Bhagavato santike etassa bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānissāmā' ti. 5.
an10.27:9.1: Evaṃ vādino bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evam assu vacanīyā:
an10.27:9.2: Eko āvuso pañho eko uddeso ekaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ, dve pañhā dve uddesā dve veyyākaraṇāni, tayo pañhā tayo uddesā tīṇi veyyākaraṇāni, cattāro pañhā cattaro uddesā cattari veyyākaraṇāni, pañca pañhā pañc' uddesā pañca veyyākaraṇāni, cha pañhā cha uddesā cha veyyākaraṇāni, satta pañhā satt' uddesā satta veyyākaraṇāni, aṭṭha pañhā aṭṭh' uddesā aṭṭha veyyākaraṇāni, nava pañhā nav' uddesā nava veyyākaraṇāni, dasa pañhā das' uddesā dasa veyyākaraṇānī ti?
an10.27:9.3: Evaṃ puṭṭhā bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā na c' eva sampāyissanti uttariñ ca vighātaṃ āpajjissanti.
an10.27:9.6: Nāhan taṃ bhikkhave passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya yo imesam pañhānaṃ veyyākaraṇena cittaṃ ārādheyya aññatra Tathāgatena vā Tathāgatasāvakena vā ito vā pana sutvā. 6.
an10.27:10.1: Eko pañho eko uddeso ekaṃ veyyākaraṇan ti
an10.27:10.2: iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñ c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ?
an10.27:10.3: Ekadhamme bhikkhave bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭh' eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hoti.
an10.27:10.6: Imasmiṃ kho bhikkhave ekadhamme bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭh' eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hoti.
an10.27:10.7: Eko pañho eko uddeso ekaṃ veyyākaraṇan ti
an10.27:10.8: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ, idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ. 7.
an10.27:11.1: Dve pañhā dve uddesā dve veyyākaraṇānī ti iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ,
an10.27:11.3: Dvīsu bhikkhave dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭh' eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hoti.
an10.27:11.6: Imesu kho bhikkhave dvīsu dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭh' eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hoti.
an10.27:11.7: Dve pañhā dve uddesā dve veyyākaraṇānī ti iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ, idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ. 8.
an10.27:12.1: Tayo pañhā tayo uddesā tīṇi veyyākaraṇānī ti iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ,
an10.27:12.3: Tīsu bhikkhave dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭh' eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hoti.
an10.27:12.6: Imesu kho bhikkhave tīsu dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭh' eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hoti.
an10.27:12.7: Tayo pañhā tayo uddesā tīṇi veyyākaraṇānī ti iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ, idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ. 9.
an10.27:13.1: Cattāro pañhā cattāro uddesā cattāri veyyākaraṇānī ti iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ,
an10.27:13.3: Catūsu bhikkhave dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭh' eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hoti.
an10.27:13.6: Imesu kho bhikkhave catūsu dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī samatthābhisamecca diṭṭh' eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hoti.
an10.27:13.7: Cattāro pañhā cattāro uddesā cattāri veyyākaraṇānī ti iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ, idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ. 10.
an10.27:14.1: Pañca pañhā pañc' uddesā pañca veyyākaraṇānī ti iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ,
an10.27:14.3: Pañcasu bhikkhave dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭh' eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hoti.
an10.27:14.6: Imesu kho bhikkhave pañcasu dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭh' eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hoti.
an10.27:14.7: Pañca pañhā pañc' uddesā pañca veyyākaraṇānī ti iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ, idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ. 11.
an10.27:15.1: Cha pañhā cha uddesā cha veyyākaraṇānī ti iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ,
an10.27:15.3: Chasu bhikkhave dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭh' eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hoti.
an10.27:15.6: Imesu kho bhikkhave chasu dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭh' eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hoti.
an10.27:15.7: Cha pañhā cha uddesā cha veyyākaraṇānī ti iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ, idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ. 12.
an10.27:16.1: Satta pañhā satt' uddesā satta veyyākaraṇānī ti iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ,
an10.27:16.3: Sattasu bhikkhave dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭh' eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hoti.
an10.27:16.6: Imesu kho bhikkhave sattasu dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭh' eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hoti.
an10.27:16.7: Satta pañhā satt' uddesā satta veyyākaraṇānī ti iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ, idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ. 13.
an10.27:17.1: Aṭṭha pañhā aṭṭh' uddesā aṭṭha veyyākaraṇānī ti iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ,
an10.27:17.3: Aṭṭhasu bhikkhave dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭh' eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hoti.
an10.27:17.6: Imesu kho bhikkhave aṭṭhasu dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭh' eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hoti.
an10.27:17.7: Aṭṭha pañhā aṭṭh' uddesā aṭṭha veyyākaraṇānī ti iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ, idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ. 14.
an10.27:18.1: Nava pañhā nav' uddesā nava veyyākaraṇānī ti iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ,
an10.27:18.3: Navasu bhikkhave dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭh' eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hoti.
an10.27:18.6: Imesu kho bhikkhave navasu dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭh' eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hoti.
an10.27:18.7: Nava pañhā nav' uddesā nava veyyākaraṇānī ti iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ, idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ. 15.
an10.27:19.1: Dasa pañhā das' uddesā dasa veyyākaraṇānī ti
an10.27:19.2: iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñ c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ?
an10.27:19.3: Dasasu bhikkhave dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭh' eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hoti.
an10.27:19.6: Imesu kho bhikkhave dasasu dhammesu bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī sammatthābhisamecca diṭṭh' eva dhamme dukkhass' antakaro hoti.
an10.27:19.7: Dasa pañhā das' uddesā dasa veyyākaraṇānī ti
an10.27:19.8: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ, idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttan
